|title=The Black Tower
|icon=Dragon
|setting=[[Royal Palace of Andor]] in [[Caemlyn]], [[Black Tower]]

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand asks [[Min]] if she would like to visit [[Black Tower|the farm]] with him, but the thought frightens her and she declines. She needs to head back to the [[Aes Sedai]] from [[Salidar]] to let them know about Rand's rules. She gives him a brief kiss before leaving. Rand can sense that [[Alanna]], the Aes Sedai who [[bonding|bonded]] him, appeared to be on edge the night before but now appears to be in good spirits; Rand suspects she is with the nine Salidar Aes Sedai. With Verin, that would bring the total to eleven. He goes to the farm without his [[Aiel]] guards.

The farm has changed a lot since his last visit. A new barn, more animals in pens, trees cleared, and some other buildings under construction. The men have started calling the farm the Black Tower as a balance to the Aes Sedai's [[White Tower]]. Rand has the students assembled. He announces that they will be training to become ''[[Asha'man]]'', which means "Guardian" in the [[Old Tongue]]. Just as the White Tower has ranks before a woman can become a full Sister, the Black Tower will have ranks before a man can become a full ''Asha'man'': [[Soldier]] and [[Dedicated]]. The rank of Dedicated will be indicated by a silver pin in the shape of a sword on one lapel; the rank of ''Asha'man ''will be indicated by a red and gold pin in the shape of a dragon on the other lapel. Rand awards both ranks to [[Mazrim Taim|Taim]] and places the pins on Taim's lapels. Taim's face looks like stone and Rand wonders what is wrong with him. Rand notices that there is no reaction from the men to his proclamation and is confused. Rand confronts Taim about his reaction during the ceremony and Taim says he disagrees about what to do about the Aes Sedai in Caemlyn and there are rumors of [[Red Ajah|Reds]] trying to intercept men coming to the farm. Rand has an argument with [[Lews Therin]] in his head. Taim can tell something is wrong and urges Rand to hang onto his sanity. Taim then says he can reduce the amount of Aes Sedai in Caemlyn, to make things safer for him and Rand threatens him that if he feels a man using the power in Caemlyn or an Aes Sedai dies mysteriously, he will make Taim pay for it.
